roll.11:
- **17 Dec 2022:** Maria volunteered at a homeless shelter, exercised, and began aerial yoga. John did kickboxing and hoped to enter local politics to improve education and infrastructure in his childhood neighborhood. He shared a school-repair photo; Maria encouraged him.
- **22 Dec 2022:** Maria donated her old car to the shelter. John sought campaign advice and stayed grounded with family picnics, games, and pizza. Maria enjoyed movies, hikes, game nights, and had made peach cobbler. John attended taekwondo.
- **1 Jan 2023:** John joined an online service group, distributed food and supplies, held a toy drive, and planned education, mentoring, job-training, and résumé support. He felt purposeful but stressed after failing a military aptitude test. They shared photos and discussed nature and life’s small joys.
- **9 Jan 2023:** Maria befriended a volunteer. John was safe after a car incident and shared a broken-windshield photo. He met community leaders and planned to address education and infrastructure.
- **28 Jan 2023:** John attended a meeting about upgrades and children’s needs; both supported better school funding. Maria comforted a lonely ~8-year-old at a shelter event until she laughed. Her aunt inspired her service; John remembered his childhood comfort doll.
- **5 Feb 2023:** Maria served meals, met David, and connected him with housing/support. John’s food drive for unemployed neighbors attracted volunteers.
- **25 Feb 2023:** Maria took creative writing and met resilient shelter resident Jean. John planned another run for office; colleague Rob invited him to beginner yoga. They discussed hope, kindness, gratitude, and community change.
- **6 Mar 2023:** Maria’s grandmother had died the previous week; John offered support. John described family life with his wife and children, including one-year-old Kyle: parks, swings, picnics, town events, and a violin concert. Maria made a London-architecture-inspired castle shadow box and painting. John retook the military aptitude test with good results and felt drawn to military service; family/friends supported him. Maria valued listening, compassion, trust, and authentic shelter relationships.
- **2 Apr 2023:** Maria said poetry helped her express feelings through a rough but worthwhile period. John graduated the previous week and shared his degree-completion certificate; he considered policymaking, especially education and infrastructure. Maria recalled their volunteering together the year before and shared a photo of a man and woman by a food tray; John remembered its impact and shared a woman and child walking in a park.
- **7 Apr 2023:** John started weekend beginner yoga with a colleague, making it daily routine; it improved his mental and physical wellbeing. He shared a man doing yoga outdoors on a blue mat. Maria ran a 5K for a homeless shelter the prior weekend and shared a group walking in the street. John volunteered at a school career fair and saw resource shortages limit children’s dreams. He shared a heart-shaped sign, “Always look on the bright side of life,” as a reminder that support helps kids reach dreams. Both committed to helping children and people in need.
- **10 Apr 2023:** John’s car broke down on the way to work the previous Friday; repair costs strained his finances, but he stayed positive. He shared a mountain-at-sunset photo with flowers, recalling a road trip the previous year along the Pacific Northwest coast and national parks. Maria praised the photo and the peace of nature. She had given talks at her homeless shelter and bought a cross necklace that made her feel closer to her faith. Shelter residents felt like family. She shared a photo of people around a table of food: she helped organize and prepare a meal for residents, bringing people together. John praised her impact and community-building; they exchanged thanks and said goodbye.

rebuild.22:

Childhood neighborhood hardship motivated him; he has run for office more than once, attends community meetings, blogs about policy, and plans projects/petitions. Also supports veterans (events, petition) and food drives. Maria supports his efforts; they volunteered together in 2022 and often plan to help locally. Dog Max died after 10 years (Jun 2023); family considered rescue adoption. Enjoys fitness, yoga, camping, hikes, sunsets, family outings; had car/money trouble Apr 2023.

Maria volunteers at homeless shelters, supports residents and children, helped David access housing (Feb 2023), and organized fundraisers (chili cook-off planned late May). Inspired by aunt’s help during family hardship. Grieved grandmother (Mar 2023); joined church (May), gym (Jun); enjoys aerial yoga, walks, music, friends. Solo Spain trip in 2022 included first surfing; also visited England and Oregon. On 2 Jul 2023, car she rode in was hit by red-light runner; everyone okay. By 3 Jul helped cousin find housing. rebuild.32:
John and Maria are close, mutually supportive friends who share a commitment to community service. John is married, has children (including son Kyle, 1 in March 2023; daughter Sara), and values family. His dog Max died in June 2023 after 10 years; family considered a rescue dog. Maria volunteers at a homeless shelter (since about Aug 2022), helps residents and fundraisers, and adopted dogs Coco (around July 28, 2023) and Shadow (Aug 6–12); she enjoys aerial yoga, friends, church, walks, and charity work.

John’s long-standing priorities are education and infrastructure, shaped by seeing neighborhood schools and roads neglected. He explored/reran for office, blogged about policy, mentored students, and advocated for community improvements. His old area suffered a severe flood June 26–July 2, 2023. He has also supported veterans through petitions, events, and a neighborhood 5K (early Aug 2023), and joined a firefighting brigade; on July 30, 2023, it rescued a family from a burning building. John lost his mechanical-engineering job Aug 5, 2023, and considered tech work.

Shared interests/memories include volunteering together in 2022, a Pacific Northwest road trip, nature, sunsets, and helping others. Maria’s aunt inspired her service; she has taken creative writing and poetry classes, traveled solo to Spain (2022), and enjoys yoga. John enjoys exercise, camping, family outings, and began yoga in 2023.
